summary: Iteration 53 Phase A + B verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 passed on /api/athletes: POST/PATCH accept role in {athlete, coach, team_rep, staff} and round-trip through GET; role omitted defaults to 'athlete'; invalid role ('captain','manager') returns 422 on both POST and PATCH; legacy 'coach' role still accepted. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844, applereview account) verified: (1) bottom tab bar shows exactly Athletes / Expenses / Comps / Schedule / Calendar / Team with NO Home tab; (2) Team tab opens Team Hub — testID team-screen present with all three coming-soon cards team-tool-roster, team-tool-gifts, team-tool-waivers rendered; (3) header home-btn present on all six tab screens (Athletes, Expenses, Comps, Schedule, Calendar, Team) and tapping it navigates to /dashboard which renders dashboard-screen; (4) /athletes/new Role selector shows all four testIDs role-athlete, role-coach, role-team_rep, role-staff in a 2x2 grid — selecting Team Rep/Mgr and saving persists, and the athletes list renders 'TEAM REP' badge (also 'COACH' badge on the seed 'Coach Maria'); (5) Calendar header regression: cal-jump opens the Jump-to modal, cal-add opens the chooser with cal-add-competition + cal-add-event, and calview-month/week/day all toggle after the split into two header rows. Login → /dashboard flow intact. No deprecated Expo packages introduced (expo-image-picker is current; no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner usage).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/core/models.py:144,156,167 — Athlete/AthleteCreate/AthleteUpdate all use Literal['athlete','coach','team_rep','staff'] so Pydantic enforces 422 on invalid role at the edge; DB round-trip preserves the string value. ✅
frontend/src/utils/roles.ts centralises the 4-role list + short/long labels + icon; athletes.tsx and new.tsx both consume it, so adding a role later is a single-source change. ✅

frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:74-76 correctly hides dashboard/reminders/settings from the tab bar via href:null, and (tabs)/team.tsx is registered — Team is the 6th visible tab; NO Home tab as required. ✅

frontend/src/components/HomeButton.tsx uses router.push('/(tabs)/dashboard') (not router.replace), so back-nav still works after tapping Home. Verified navigation Athletes→Home→Athletes preserves tab state. ✅

frontend/app/(tabs)/athletes.tsx:137-142 only renders the coach/rep/staff badge for non-'athlete' roles — clean UX so plain athletes aren't decorated. Uses roleShort().toUpperCase() so labels stay short (COACH / TEAM REP / STAFF). ✅
frontend/app/athletes/new.tsx:296-300 roleChip uses flexBasis:'48%' + flexGrow:1 with flexWrap on the wrapper, so 4 chips render as a true 2x2 grid on 390-wide mobile — visually confirmed. ✅

frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx split into headerBar + viewToggleRow (line 204) — cal-jump, cal-add, cal-today, home-btn all live in one row; month/week/day toggle in a second right-aligned row. Regression clean.

(tabs)/team.tsx uses SafeAreaView with edges=['top'] and header layout consistent with the other tab screens; testID team-screen is on the ScrollView (line 39) so parents/coaches will see it once tools ship.
seed_data_creation: Temp athletes prefixed TEST_ created by pytest (auto-cleaned via fixture teardown) and one UI-driven TEST_UI_TeamRep athlete created + deleted via API cleanup script. No seed data leaked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A/B nav upgrade is GREEN. Team Hub landing is intentionally 'coming soon' — Phase C will need real tools behind team-tool-roster/gifts/waivers. Athlete role Literal is the single source of truth (backend/core/models.py + frontend/src/utils/roles.ts) — keep them in sync when adding roles. Bottom tab count is 6; adding a 7th would need Tabs.Screen icon spacing review on iPhone SE widths.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
